name: csoai
description: CSOAI measured board tools over MCP JSON-RPC. Proxies live /api/gspc, /api/east-west, /api/ecosystem, /api/verify-tally, /api/benchmark-quality, /api/instruments.

servers.name: csoai-measured
servers.description: First-party measured APIs via JSON-RPC tools/list + tools/call. No LLM-as-judge. Measurement, not certification.

measured.note: Verify with POST {jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,method:'tools/list'} to /api/mcp. Tally is self-reported opt-in — not a MEASURED number.
